text: Deploy directly by connecting a repo, with automatic build config and instant previews
quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.

text: Visualize and design entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas
quote: Craft on a visual canvas that makes your entire stack visible at a glance.

text: Edit service settings directly on the canvas without needing YAML config
quote: Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.

text: Private service-to-service networking available automatically at deploy time
quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.

text: Public endpoints with SSL provided automatically from the moment of deploy
quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.

text: Load balancing is live automatically as soon as a service is deployed
quote: Private connections, public endpoints, SSL, and load balancing live from the moment you deploy.

text: Automatically handles HTTP, TCP, gRPC, and WebSocket protocols
quote: HTTP, TCP, gRPC, WebSockets handled automatically.

text: Scale services by adjusting CPU/RAM or adding load-balanced replicas
quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.

text: Deploy applications to regions closer to end users
quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.

text: Build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
quote: Create custom dashboards with metrics from any service.

text: Send Slack, Discord, or email alerts when specified conditions are met

text: View all build, deploy, and runtime logs in one unified place

text: Spin up unlimited environments so the whole team can ship simultaneously
quote: Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.

text: Every pull request automatically gets its own preview environment
quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.

text: Instantly roll back a deployment to any previous version
quote: Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.

text: Set hard spending limits to control cloud costs
quote: really gotta commend @Railway for allowing hard spending limits, I have never, ever seen this with any cloud provider.
